Hi Logan,

We’re kicking off a scoped SOC2 evidence collection for Compass Health and our auditor has asked for a compact package focused on employee vetting and training for any vendors that touch PHI. Specifically we need:

- Summary of background check coverage (types run, vendor, date ranges)
- Training completion transcripts for security/privacy training for the last 24 months
- Onboarding and offboarding process documentation and a small sample of logs showing deprovisioning actions
- A short attestation signed by an authorized Redwood rep confirming processes reflect current practice

Can you confirm whether you can provide a redacted package and an estimate for delivery? Our review window is narrow — initial intake is due to auditors by end of next week (9/19).

Thanks,
